text_block_list.text:
Today was a day off—so I went to check out 
a recreational event organized by horse 
girls who voluntarily gathered 
participants.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Oh! If it ain't Trainer! We were just 
short one member. Join in with us for the 
water gun battle!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fumu. So the rule is to shoot colored 
water at each other. ...If it's colored, I 
could easily slip in that concoction 
instead and no one would notice...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............ ...In this venue... there 
is... something here.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...You're talking about the other 
participants, right? Hey? HEY, OI!!

And so, I joined the tournament on the 
same team as Jungle Pocket and the others, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... coming from the 12 o'clock 
direction... here they come...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, enemy team?! All right, let's blast 
'em—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... something else... ...So many... so 
many of them...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaagh?! Oi oi oi oi!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, if you shoot blindly you'll run 
out of water. Good grief, I suppose I have 
no choice but to use what I formulated 
earlier—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Formulated what?! We don't need that!

text_block_list.name: Enemy Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Dahaha! Look at those guys, they're 
fighting among themselves! Fire, fireee!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oi! We're completely surrounded already?! 
Doesn't anybody have a strategy or 
something?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's go with that! Tachyon, 
Cafe, scatter plan!

text_block_list.name: Pocket & Tachyon
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, why the hell is everyone running 
in the same direction?! We ain't scattered 
at ALL!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, one cannot take proper action 
without details. Scattering must have an 
objective, no? Is it to retreat, or to 
attack?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I heard a voice saying 'this way.' 
...My impression is rather that... 
everyone followed me...
choice_data_list:
From now on, let's properly coordinate a 
strategy—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ............ Nah. Change of plans.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
At the eleventh hour, I just remembered 
something important. Listen up. Listen 
good. The strategy is—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —'NO STRATEGY' AT ALL!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Any of you wanna take my 
head?! Come at me all at once!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(Fumu... Knowing Pokke-kun, she'll just 
charge head-on loudly anyway.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(Which effectively serves as a 
diversion—meaning an attack from the 
flanks will be most optimal.)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(...Pokke-san and Tachyon-san fighting— 
either way... it's definitely going to 
cause an uproar...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(I'll target the other teams... drawn into 
the commotion. As for the location... I'll 
have 'them' tell me...)

And so... the result of the 'abandon 
strategy' strategy. Unbelievably, the 
three of them began coordinating 
seamlessly, magnificently pushing back the 
opposing teams!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Our engines are finally revving 
up, guys!
choice_data_list: You two are totally in sync.
You two are totally in sync.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Our engines are finally revving 
up, guys!
choice_data_list: You two are totally in sync.
You two are totally in sync.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! We're taking... the top spot!

—And after that, the team's winning streak 
continued—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Alright! We won the whole championship—!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fumu. Quite a meaningful event. Group 
warfare... I was able to thoroughly 
observe human psychology under conflict.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm also glad... that I could interact 
with 'everyone' here...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Gahahaha, what's with that?! We just won 
the championship, and even our impressions 
are all over the place!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Well, who cares! As long as we all 
agree it was a total blast!

—And after that, the team's momentum 
continued, but—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Alright! That makes ten in a row!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My, my, on a roll, aren't we? If it's the 
Pokke-kun I know, this is about when she'd 
let out a roar of triumph.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed... And then... she'd let her 
guard down...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Uwooooh! I ain't done rampaging yet! I can 
still go on—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she got hit. Haha, exactly as we 
predicted.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Tell me with your words beforehand, 
dammit!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Right, we could totally pull off a normal 
strategy now, right? Like Operation Zeus 
Impact, or Operation Hyper Dive—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Cease that. Yours doesn't even qualify as 
a strategy in the first place. Rather, we 
should enact my Operation Hydroxyapatite—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...How about... my Operation Hour of the 
Ox...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Idiots! If all of us make our own plan, 
it's no different from having no plan at 
all! More importantly—

text_block_list.name: Enemy Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
What, are they arguing?! Alright, free 
kill—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
SHUT UP! Out-of-bounds bystanders stay out 
of it!

—Even if their words never align, they 
somehow remain completely in sync. The 
team's heroics continued on afterward...
